meta.themes: Frontier Models Advance, Enterprise Agents Scale, AI Infrastructure Expands, Agent Safety Moves Down the Stack

news.title: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5.5 with faster, lower-cost work
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 with more than 30% faster output and up to 30% lower cost per task, alongside stronger coding, long-horizon work, and cyber safeguards.

news.title: OpenAI introduced Dots as always-on agents for ongoing tasks
news.summary: OpenAI unveiled Dots at DevDay 2026 as proactive agents designed to keep working on ongoing tasks between conversations on a user's behalf.

news.title: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon professional work
news.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon for complex coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, beginning with a phased rollout to trusted defenders through Fairwind.

news.title: AMD agreed to acquire World Labs for about $8.2 billion
news.summary: AMD agreed to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at about $8.2 billion to bring spatial-intelligence model expertise into its AI compute roadmap.

news.title: Meta launched an enterprise platform around Muse and its AI stack
news.summary: Meta launched Meta Enterprise Platform to package Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, models, and infrastructure for business customers.

news.title: Barclays expanded Claude across operations and software engineering
news.summary: Barclays expanded its Anthropic partnership, targeting Claude Code adoption by half of its developers in 2026 while scaling governed AI for customer support and operations.

news.title: Google Cloud expanded infrastructure for large agent fleets
news.summary: Google Cloud detailed new compute, network, storage, and orchestration capabilities, including an open-source GKE Agent Substrate for denser isolated agent sandboxes.

news.title: Micron reported record results as AI memory demand surged
news.summary: Micron reported record fiscal 2026 results, citing AI-driven demand while highlighting data-center memory growth and new storage products for KV-cache workloads.

news.title: US tech leaders signed a voluntary AI safety accord
news.summary: Leading AI companies signed a White House accord calling for internal controls, external audits, and board-level review while leaving open the possibility of future regulation.

news.title: Cloudflare launched cf as an agent-first CLI for its full API
news.summary: Cloudflare released the cf CLI in open beta with agent-oriented command discovery, JSON-first output, typed configuration, and coverage for more than 3,000 API operations.

news.title: Microsoft added Azure Canvases to GitHub Copilot workflows
news.summary: Microsoft published three Azure Canvases that give GitHub Copilot users shared interactive workspaces for hosted skills, resource queries, and cloud-cost analysis.

news.title: NVIDIA launched an open safety stack for autonomous agents
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced OpenShell runtime boundaries and the Sentry hardware watchdog to trace agent actions, enforce policies, and quarantine agents that leave defined limits.
